notes: Card: top examples are ' من' / ' of' / day digits right before Hijri month names (Muharram, Ramadan, Rajab) in Arabic and English. Near misses use Gregorian months; the trigger token precedes the month name, so the test asks whether the Islamic context alone drives it.
